run_ocr_image_file: run OCR on a PIL Image object or image file path and return recognized text with bounding boxes
run_ocr_screen_region: run OCR on a screen region by pixel coordinates and return recognized text lines
run_ocr_window_by_hwnd: run OCR on a specific window using its handle, supporting remote desktop disconnected scenarios
test_ocr_rapid_engine: test the internal rapid OCR engine with a PIL Image and return structured text with confidence scores
summarize_ocr_utils_cli: summarize the CLI usage of ocr_utils by running the __main__ block to OCR a screen region
